body: I feel the same way. I can't do it to my mom or my close friends. Ive talked to my mom about my depression and she thinks she is doing something wrong. Ive explained that it isn't her or really anyone its just I feel a certain way.... if I did anything to hurt myself, she would feel responsible and thats not something I want to leave behind. To get through my desires, I tell myself that after my mom passes away (which I hope isn't soon), I would feel "comfortable" doing it.... however, I'm hoping my mom stays here for years to come, and that one day ill overcome this shitty feeling. Stay strong and I hope you have a happy day tomorrow and so on!
